bot.name: PurpleWave
bot.description: An all-race opponent by Dan Gant with a broad strategy repertoire, precise unit control, and persistent opponent history.

formats.notes: sb.6 completed natural 1v1 games as Protoss, Terran and Zerg on x64 and x86. Terran selected worker rush; broader strategic coverage remains scoped. Saved-history reload verified. docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Opponent history, placement caches, and logs stay in the isolated profile. Reset read and write to the empty baseline to clear learning; compatible history is preserved across updates.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Modified ShieldBattery build. Package includes upstream attribution, modification notices, source, and dependency licenses.

localDistribution.evidence: Scoped source, runtime effects, source-delivery and complete notice review of exact sb.6 build. Public competition remains unreviewed. docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Separate from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Requires gathered-resource and train-cancellation bridge fixes documented in docs/releases/purplewave-sb-5-bridge-review.md.
Natural 1v1 results cover all assigned races on x86/x64; Random, other formats, unusual maps and exhaustive late-game behavior remain unverified.
Source/runtime tracing has the documented native/JFR limits and is not an OS sandbox. Human difficulty and public competition remain unreviewed.
Installed-package and UI checks are recorded separately in docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md; no public publication is implied.

sourceReview.evidence: Exact sb.6 source/JAR delta and packaged-source offline rebuild reviewed; unchanged dependencies retain scoped source/native review. docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md
